invariants.rationale: The returned list is always instantiated as an ArrayList and is returned at the end.
The method logic expects a valid partitionPath, and it is passed directly into internal calls.
All SmallFile instances added to the result are newly created and non-null.
A SmallFile is only added to the result if its file size is strictly less than the configured small file threshold.
Each constructed SmallFile is assigned a non-null HoodieRecordLocation before being added to the result.
